name: hexagonal pyramid
description: Regular hexagonal pyramid inscribed in the unit sphere: apex at the north pole, base at ``z = -1/3`` with radius ``2 sqrt(2) / 3``. One vertex of valence 6 among six of valence 3, and one hexagon among six triangles. That spread is what separates R1 from R2. Its polar dual is again a hexagonal pyramid, inverted.
